name: object-images-contract-spec
doc: Data contract for the object_images table containing image URLs and metadata for museum objects, including primary images, additional images, and creation timestamps.

object_id.description: Identifying number for each artwork (unique, can be used as key field)

primary_image.description: URL to the primary image of an object (JPEG)

additional_images.description: Array of URLs to additional JPEG images of the object

created_at.description: Timestamp when this record was created in the database

In this exercise, artwork means one museum object record identified by object.object_id. This is a local counting convention, not evidence that every collection item is classified as an artwork in Linked Art. Do not count images, tags, or conceptual works as extra objects.

Artist name is object.artist_display_name; title is object.title; department is object_gallery_info.department; culture is object_history.culture; classification and medium are in object_physical_properties; primary image URL is object_images.primary_image; public-domain status is object_copyright.is_public_domain. Use the stated field, not a related label or proxy.

For populated text use NULLIF(BTRIM(column), '') IS NOT NULL; for missing text use NULLIF(BTRIM(column), '') IS NULL. Combine conditions with AND or OR exactly as asked. For object counts count object IDs, not distinct field values. For distinct values use DISTINCT; for counts per category GROUP BY that category. Join only the tables needed, using qualified object_id columns. Preserve the requested row grain and avoid extra columns.

The query tool returns columns and rows. Submit only its complete rows array as the final rows value, preserving numbers, strings, NULLs, duplicates, and row order. Do not return SQL, column names, explanations, or numbers remembered from other questions.

additionalProfiles.purpose: Map the locally proposed sculpture group to Linked Art physical objects and its recommended Sculpture concept. The source-label mapping remains a workshop assertion, not a mapping published or endorsed by the Met or Linked Art.
additionalProfiles.approved_instructions: Describe the mapped sculpture records using Linked Art JSON-LD. Count physical sculpture identities by their class and classification URI, not their display labels.

Represent each selected sculpture object with Linked Art type HumanMadeObject. Physical objects, digital files, and visual content have distinct identities; do not count images or VisualItems as extra physical objects.

Use the full Sculpture URI http://vocab.getty.edu/aat/300047090 in classified_as, with Type of Work http://vocab.getty.edu/aat/300435443 as its classification. Collection Item and Artwork are separate concepts. Do not infer Artwork merely from collection membership or substitute its URI for Sculpture.

linkedArt.mapping_relation: Assert the broader Sculpture work type for records bearing any listed source label; do not assert exact equivalence of the label with the vocabulary concept.
linkedArt.unknown_policy: Unclassified records remain unknown; classified labels outside the explicit mapping remain unmapped.
linkedArt.artwork_policy: Do not infer the Artwork classification from collection membership.
linkedArt.count_unit: One physical object identity per source objectID.

additionalProfiles.title: Met sample sculpture prompt application profile
additionalProfiles.purpose: Apply the shared Linked Art Sculpture concept to the existing Met sample classification agreement through prompt instructions. No database schema, query-tool behavior, or upstream definition is changed.
additionalProfiles.approved_instructions:
Translate the question into one PostgreSQL SELECT using the supplied schema. Resolve the entity, field, missing-value rule, aggregation, and requested output before writing SQL. Use the semantic rules below. After the query succeeds, copy its result rows exactly into the final answer; do not recalculate or substitute values. No retries are allowed.
Linked Art reference, embedded from the local recommended vocabulary (Object Types):
Sculpture (http://vocab.getty.edu/aat/300047090): Object created by carving or engraving a hard material or molding a malleable material
Workshop application: use the supplied source-category mapping for membership.
Local application profile for this Met sample: the supplied sculpture_categories list is the complete operational membership rule. The Linked Art description supplies the shared concept; it does not replace these source labels or authorize guessing membership from titles, media, or materials. Material, scale, and architectural variants in that list remain included. This local mapping is not an assertion that each Met label is exactly equivalent to the shared concept.
Choose the scope from the question. Questions about artworks or the whole sample use all object records, unless the question explicitly requests sculptures. Do not apply the sculpture list to general artwork questions.
For mapped sculptures, compare the trimmed classification against every label in sculpture_categories. Preserve both word orders and spelling variants: Sculpture-Wood and Wood-Sculpture are separate labels, as are Stone Sculpture, Stone-Sculpture, and Sculpture-Stone. Before submitting the query, check that none of the listed labels was omitted.
If the question asks for mapped sculptures other than the exact label Sculpture, apply the complete membership list AND exclude that exact label. Do not count every object outside the exact label. Unknown membership means NULL or blank classification. Unmapped means a populated classification outside the complete list; exclude NULL, empty, and space-only values from that count. Neither unknown nor unmapped establishes that an object is not a sculpture. Use the supplied schema, qualified columns, and explicit joins for every referenced table. Do not invent nested table paths or extra tables.

localDefinition.membership: Trim surrounding spaces using PostgreSQL BTRIM and match the complete sculpture_categories list exactly. Preserve spelling, punctuation, and word-order variants.
localDefinition.scope: Apply sculpture membership only when the question requests sculptures. General artwork/sample questions retain the full object population.
localDefinition.relation: A local broader-concept assertion for this workshop; not exact equivalence between every Met label and the AAT concept.
localDefinition.exclude_exact_label: For mapped sculptures other than the exact label Sculpture, apply membership AND exclude that label.
localDefinition.unknown: NULL, empty, and space-only source classifications remain unknown.
localDefinition.unmapped: Other populated source classifications remain unmapped, not evidence of non-sculpture.
localDefinition.inference_boundary: No automatic runtime enforcement or SQL rewrite. The model must follow these prompt rules; the MAP check verifies the prompt configuration, not the generated answers.

review.basis: Desk review of classification, title, medium, and objectID in the checked-in sample; no image inspection or curator validation.
review.decision: Retain the existing 17-category agreement. No membership or gold answers changed to accommodate an eval failure.
